title: Denver Beer Spa: Colorado's Most Unique Spa Experience For Two
includes: 90-minute private spa suite access that includes infrared sauna, rain shower and your own private hydrotherapy tub.
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The Only Beer Spa Experience of Its Kind in the U.S.

It is not your typical day spa; it’s a unique, award-winning experience that blends wellness, self-care, and craft beer and wine in a cozy, upscale setting. You’ll relax in a private spa suite featuring a beer-inspired soak (yes, you bathe in ingredients used to brew beer!), an infrared sauna, and a rain shower, all while sipping a curated selection of local craft brews or non alcoholic beverages. Whether you're traveling solo, as a couple, or with friends, Oakwell offers a playful yet rejuvenating escape that you won't find anywhere else in Denver, Colorado, and the U.S.
